name: Polaris
author: Matthias Stache
description: Bar widget for Polaris, a project memory for AI chats, meetings, mails and documents: shows new material per project, starts curation with your own AI CLI, opens the knowledge files, and a health check for capture, curation, backup, machine memory and security. Requires Polaris.

barWidget.description: Polaris project memory: pending sources, curation runs and health check
